prompt: Create a complete original 60-second instrumental cue in kora style. Use kora, calabash, shakers, soft bass. Tempo 112 BPM. Immediate short melodic hook and steady rhythm from the first beat. Keep this groove present until the final bar. In the final second, all instruments play one resolved tonic chord and stop together, allowing a short clean natural tail. This must end musically, with no fade and no abrupt unfinished phrase. No slow intro, silent gap, long outro or atmospheric wash. Pure instrumental performance: instruments exclusively. No human voice, speech, singing, humming, choir, vocal samples or crowd sounds anywhere.
